records.title: Focusing on What Matters: Saliency-Harnessing Accurate Routing for Diffusion MoE
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a powerful paradigm for scaling diffusion models in visual generation. Recent advancements have focused on adaptively allocating computational resources across diverse tokens to improve efficiency and performance. records.title: PAMAE: Phase-Aware-MoE Action Experts Towards Reliable Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Reliable action generation for multi-stage robotic manipulation remains challenging for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While existing flow-matching VLA policies offer strong multimodal grounding and generalization, they typically employ a single shared action expert, limiting their ability to capture phase-specific control patterns across distinct execution stages. We propose a plug-and-play Phase-Aware Mixture… Out of scope: Robotic VLA action-policy training and quality.

records.title: Smaller Models, Unexpected Costs: Trade-offs in LLM Quantization for Automated Program Repair
records.reason: This is a useful negative measurement of quantization tradeoffs, but it does not propose an efficiency gain and its latency/energy evidence has a single-run, task-specific limitation.

records.title: RSPC: A Benchmark for Modeling Stress and Psychiatric Conditions in Digitally Mediated Relationships using Psychiatrist Annotations
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: In NLP, mental health conditions are often modeled as isolated phenomena, without interpersonal context.
